sql.value: select l.id, l.user_id, u.username as user_name, l.api_key_id, k.name as api_key_name, l.endpoint, l.http_method, l.model_id, l.model_name, l.provider_type, l.conversation_id, l.request_id, l.prompt_snippet, l.output_snippet, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.total_tokens, l.cost, l.latency_ms, l.status, l.error_msg, l.ip, l.user_agent, l.create_time from ai_audit_log l left join sys_user u on u.id = l.user_id left join ai_api_key k on k.id = l.api_key_id where 1 = 1 #[and l.user_id = :userId] #[and l.api_key_id = :apiKeyId] #[and l.model_id = :modelId] #[and l.endpoint like concat('%', :endpoint, '%')] #[and l.status = :status] #[and l.create_time >= :startTime] #[and l.create_time <= :endTime] order by l.id desc
